items.title: Coca-Cola (KO) Faces Supply Chain Scrutiny, Is The Stock Already Fully Valued?
items.summary: Indian authorities recently seized thousands of beverage cartons in an alleged expiry date relabeling case, with Coca-Cola (KO) products among those affected through a third party exporter. For investors, the spotlight is on supply chain oversight and brand protection. Coca-Cola shares have eased in the very short term, with a 1-day share price return of 0.76% and a 7-day share price return of 3.97%. However, the stock still shows strong momentum, with a 90-day share price return of 11.73%...
